description: Sample Jira-style security vulnerability issues for import into Dude AI.

fields.description: Sample security finding: passwords may be exposed through API responses, application logs, or error messages. Verify in an authorized test environment.
Sample security finding: internal user identifiers may be exposed or user records may be accessible without proper authorization.
Sample security finding: confidential revenue figures or financial reports may be accessible without appropriate permissions.
Sample security finding: a file upload may contain suspicious content that requires investigation using approved security tools in an isolated environment.
Sample security finding: a protected API endpoint may fail to verify whether a user is authorized to access a requested resource.

fields.summary: Sensitive Data Leakage in API Response
fields.description: Sample security finding: an API response may expose confidential personal or business information that is not required by the client.
